title: Retarget the literal Gradle Minecraft version
preconditions: Exact supported source and target; review all dependencies and mappings.
The designated configuration field occurs once and contains the exact source value.
postconditions: Only the designated value changes and reparsing returns the exact target value.
behavioral_differences: The project requests the new game dependency or advertises it to the loader. Gameplay compatibility requires independent verification.
limitations: Single-module conventional Fabric layout using Mojang mappings.
Generated metadata, Java API changes and version ranges require review.
verification_evidence: Original sample configuration and regression tests for exact value, drift, and idempotent replay.
